# ASin <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Math](Language-Features-Math)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ASin:Float32 float:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `float` | In | Float32 | required | The sine, from -1 to 1. |

**Returns:** The angle in degrees.

## Description

Returns the angle whose sine is the given number. The result is in degrees, from -90 to 90.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print ASin(0.5)
```

```text
30.0
```
